findings.text: the tree evidence is consulted only when the parsed list is empty: _changed_path_entries returns the parsed entries whenever they are non-empty (:1794 `if items: return items`), so `changed_paths: none, no repository change` arrives as ('no repository change',) and _changed_paths_declare_no_paths's first test never sees the token that names a real changed file called none; the raw-field reading then honours the declaration and the run promotes with no commit, where the dispatch base refused. Measured through crew.complete in the head tree and a copy of the base tree: `none, no repository change` PROMOTED at head / REFUSED at base, and `none. review only` PROMOTED at head / REFUSED at base, each over a repository that really committed a changed file named none with commits: none. Nothing in tests/test_commitless_review_promotes.py covers a prose value over a tree holding a file of that name, so the docstring's guarantee (:1833-1836 'A first entry that names a file in the promoted tree settles it as a path list at once - evidence the shape reading cannot overrule') holds only for a whole-value single token; _first_changed_path_is_a_file (:1809) also says 'file' where _path_exists_in_run_tree (:1757) accepts any existing path, and 'the promoted revision's tree' where the check reads the run's recorded repo/worktree.

the head gate's own header names revision 1d37a921 as head ('revision: 1d37a921... head; tree: 83d9f4ba...') while the run head is fe2904b4 and the reviewed worktree is at fe2904b4: git diff --name-status 1d37a921..fe2904b4 lists only the evidence fragment, so the code the gate measured equals the head's code and the evidence transfers, but the after-suite revision recorded in the manifest (1d37a921) differs from the reviewed head revision (fe2904b4) and a reader must resolve that delta themselves to trust the gate.
